title: CoreApiSimpleFinAccount
description: A SimpleFIN account as core stores it (#545). `entityId` is the entity its transactions are stored under, or null while it has none: sync then stores none of them. `balanceCents` is a signed integer in the minor unit of `currency`, or null when SimpleFIN sent a malformed balance; `balanceAt` is when SimpleFIN measured it, or null. `backfillPending` is true from the account's first assignment until its older transactions have been read.
